name: The Elder Crone
summary: Seereth Stonebreak sends word from Stonetalon to Thunder Bluff. Goblin deforestation and mining have enraged the mountain's elements, and Seereth seeks spiritual guidance from Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise.

sections.title: Cry from Stonetalon
sections.body: In Stonetalon Mountains, goblin deforestation and mining have enraged the elemental spirits. Seereth Stonebreak sees that force alone cannot ease the land's anguish. So Seereth turns to elder shamans for wisdom. Few tribal leaders are known to Seereth by name, but Magatha Grimtotem is known for her wisdom and commanding presence.

sections.title: Audience on Elder Rise
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem holds court atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where shamanic and spiritual affairs gather. Her tribe's ties with Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership are tense and often confrontational. Even so, Magatha is a formidable elder whose counsel carries great weight across the Horde. You bring her Stonetalon's troubles and seek her guidance.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Alliance
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem sends word of the elemental turmoil to the Forsaken alchemists living in the city. She does not rely only on traditional tauren rites. Instead, she draws the Horde's newest and most cynical allies into Kalimdor's spiritual affairs. Her answer shows a cunning and unconventional way of handling power and problems.

faq.q: Who sends me to find Magatha?
faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak sends you from Stonetalon Mountains after you fight the Venture Company goblins cutting through the mountain forests.
Magatha Grimtotem lives atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. The northeastern bluff is linked to the central mesa by wooden bridges.

faq.q: Why is Seereth asking an elder tauren for help?
faq.answer: Goblin industry has disturbed Stonetalon's spirits. Seereth sees that force alone cannot heal the land, so seeks spiritual guidance to calm the elements.

Magatha Grimtotem is the elder crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe. Her fiercely aggressive tribe is skeptical of the united Horde, while Magatha holds great political and spiritual influence atop Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Magatha?
faq.answer: After hearing your report on Stonetalon, Magatha sends you to Apothecary Zamah, a Forsaken emissary in the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise, for help.

faq.q: Why is this quest called 'The Elder Crone'?
faq.answer: The title refers to Magatha Grimtotem. Her clan and the wider tauren people know her as the Elder Crone for her great age, shamanic knowledge, and authority as matriarch.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the fragile balance between Cairne's united tribes and the aloof, fiercely traditional Grimtotem, who dwell in Thunder Bluff.
As a shaman, you know the weight of Stonetalon's elemental unrest. Seeking Magatha's counsel on Elder Rise reflects the spiritual crisis in Kalimdor's peaks.
You see the Horde's ties at work as Stonetalon's frontier troubles reach the high halls of Thunder Bluff's leadership.
